title: anim.bake_order/1
description: data/anim/bake_order.json: the pose bake's order and what a slice may start (docs/animation/bake-pace.md; AnimData.bake_pending, _queue). first: the poses a fight asks for, the dear ones first, in the order a fight asks for them, so the queue bakes them before the rest; cost: the microseconds each pose takes to bake on the measuring PC (the minimum of three runs, to 100), so a slice does not start a pose that would take it past its budget. Only the order and the pace change: every pose is baked from the same sketch. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every pose in `first` has a cost) are checked by tools/lib/xref-*.

first.description: Pose ids in the order the queue bakes them first.

cost.description: Microseconds a pose takes to bake, by pose id, to 100.
